assumptions: C3 is a rigid heavy truck, not the Cascadia tractor; this contrast is not tractor-only calibration.
The public model includes its rigid body and loaded configuration; those effects cannot be separated.
No semitrailer is included in this sensitivity, but this does not prove a matched tractor-only amount.
Use only MX bobtail kilometres; the attached tractor-box composite continues covering attached kilometres.
Fuel and driver compensation already cover all MX tractor kilometres and must not be added again.
No change to box, US tractor, capital, administration, capacity, time or yard allocation is made here.
No fifty-fifty or ten-eighteenths split of the T3S2 composite is supported or applied.
The four printed monetary expenses are used; rounded quantities times rounded prices would differ.
The 2025 net model is transferred without invented inflation, fees or a claim of invoice tax recovery.
The October 1 2026 FIX translates MXN to USD but does not make source periods a joint cohort.
The link forecast and postal road reference must be enabled explicitly for this optional sensitivity.
The unpriced default and actual tractor-only amount remain null; no unknown is certified as zero.
